8:T3d13,<main id="main" class="shell legal">
      <header class="page-hero">
        <p class="eyebrow">Legal · Interim pilot notice</p>
        <h1>Privacy Notice</h1>
        <p>
          This notice explains how Aynera collects and uses personal data for our website, early-access list, forms, and the planned app.
          It is a thorough interim notice aligned with common dating-platform practice and India’s DPDP direction.
          It is <strong>not</strong> the final counsel-approved policy.
        </p>
        <p>Last updated: 13 August 2026. Language: English.</p>
      </header>

      <h2 id="toc">Contents</h2>
      <ol class="legal-toc">
        <li><a href="#p1">Who we are / data fiduciary</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p2">Scope</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p3">Data we collect</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p4">Device permissions and signals</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p5">Verification, liveness, and biometrics</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p6">How we use data</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p7">Communications</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p8">Legal bases / consent</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p9">Sharing</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p10">Advertising and “do not sell”</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p11">International transfers</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p12">Retention</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p13">Account deletion effects</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p14">Security</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p15">Your rights (including export)</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p16">Children</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p17">Cookies and similar tech</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p18">Safety and messaging</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p19">Grievance and privacy contact</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p20">Language</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p21">Changes</a></li>
        <li><a href="#p22">Contact</a></li>
      </ol>

      <h2 id="p1">1. Who we are / data fiduciary</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">We are the data fiduciary for Aynera processing described here (DPDP terminology; counsel to confirm).</p>
      <div class="legal-callout">
        <strong>To be published before public launch:</strong> legal entity name, registered address, CIN (if any), and whether Aynera is notified as a Significant Data Fiduciary.
        Interim contact: <a class="text-link" href="mailto:grievance@aynera.in">grievance@aynera.in</a>.
      </div>
      <p>
        Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the organisation that determines the purpose and means of processing personal data is a Data Fiduciary.
        Until entity details are published, “Aynera”, “we”, and “us” mean the operators of this website and the planned app.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p2">2. Scope</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">This covers the website now and describes planned app practices.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Visitors to Aynera marketing pages</li>
        <li>Early-access registrants</li>
        <li>People who submit suggestions or grievances</li>
        <li>Future app members</li>
      </ul>

      <h2 id="p3">3. Data we collect</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">We collect what we need to invite you, run the product, and keep people safer.</p>
      <h3>A. Early access and website forms</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>Name (first and last), phone, email, launch city, interest type</li>
        <li>Age confirmation and marketing consent</li>
        <li>Suggestion / grievance message content</li>
      </ul>
      <h3>B. Technical and security data</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>IP address, user agent, timestamps, rate-limit and abuse signals</li>
        <li>Basic diagnostics / crash data in the future app</li>
      </ul>
      <h3>C. Planned app account and profile data</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>Account identifiers; phone/email confirmation status</li>
        <li>Profile details you choose to share</li>
        <li>Introduction, Focus, Together, and Era space activity needed to operate those features</li>
        <li>Reports, blocks, and safety case notes</li>
      </ul>
      <h3>D. Communications metadata</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>Delivery status for email/SMS/push where available</li>
        <li>Support correspondence</li>
      </ul>

      <h2 id="p4">4. Device permissions and signals</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Permissions are requested only when a feature needs them.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Camera / microphone for liveness or media you choose to capture</li>
        <li>Photo library for uploads you choose</li>
        <li>Notifications for product and safety alerts</li>
        <li>Approximate location only if a location feature is enabled and allowed by you</li>
      </ul>
      <p>Revoking a permission may disable related features. We do not use permissions for unrelated advertising.</p>

      <h2 id="p5">5. Verification, liveness, and biometrics</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Liveness checks are for authenticity; raw media is not kept longer than needed.</p>
      <p>
        To reduce fake profiles, we may process short video-selfie / liveness captures and related review signals.
        This may involve biometric or biometric-adjacent processing under applicable law. We use it to verify that a real person is creating or maintaining an account — not to sell biometric templates.
      </p>
      <ul>
        <li>Raw capture media is processed for the verification event and deleted or de-identified when no longer needed for verification, fraud review, or legal defence</li>
        <li>We may retain a verification outcome (for example pass/fail, timestamp, reviewer notes) longer than the raw media</li>
        <li>Professionals credential documents, if collected, are used only for that review and stored with access limits</li>
      </ul>
      <p>Exact retention windows will be set with counsel and vendors before public launch.</p>

      <h2 id="p6">6. How we use data</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Operate Aynera, protect users, and improve introductions.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Create and manage early-access records and future accounts</li>
        <li>Send launch invitations and service messages</li>
        <li>Run verification and human review</li>
        <li>Provide introductions, Focus, Together, Era space, and related features</li>
        <li>Prevent fraud, spam, underage use, and abuse</li>
        <li>Investigate reports and enforce Terms / Safety rules</li>
        <li>Analyse product performance using aggregated or de-identified insights where possible</li>
        <li>Meet legal, tax, and app-store requirements</li>
      </ul>

      <h2 id="p7">7. Communications</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">OTPs and security messages differ from marketing.</p>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Transactional / security:</strong> OTPs, login alerts, grievance replies — needed to provide the service you requested</li>
        <li><strong>Marketing / launch:</strong> early-access and product updates with consent where required; unsubscribe available</li>
        <li><strong>Push:</strong> optional; controllable in device or app settings after launch</li>
      </ul>
      <p>We do not ask you to share OTPs with support agents in chat.</p>

      <h2 id="p8">8. Legal bases / consent</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Consent and service delivery, subject to final DPDP wording.</p>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Consent:</strong> marketing emails; optional profile fields; certain sensitive processing where law requires consent</li>
        <li><strong>Contract / service delivery:</strong> processing needed to provide the Services you request</li>
        <li><strong>Legitimate use / compliance:</strong> security, fraud prevention, legal obligations, and safety investigations as permitted by law</li>
      </ul>
      <p>You may withdraw marketing consent without losing essential service notices.</p>

      <h2 id="p9">9. Sharing</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">We share with processors and when law or safety requires it.</p>
      <ul>
        <li><strong>Service providers:</strong> hosting, email/SMS, analytics, support tools, identity/liveness vendors</li>
        <li><strong>Other members:</strong> profile information you choose to make visible; mutual feature states as needed</li>
        <li><strong>Legal and safety:</strong> regulators, courts, or law enforcement when required; disclosures to protect users from serious harm</li>
        <li><strong>Business transfers:</strong> merger or restructuring under continued protection commitments</li>
      </ul>

      <h2 id="p10">10. Advertising and “do not sell”</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">We do not sell personal data.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>We do not sell your personal information for money.</li>
        <li>We do not share personal data with third parties for their independent cross-app advertising profiles.</li>
        <li>If we later run ads on our own properties, we will update this notice and offer choices required by law.</li>
      </ul>

      <h2 id="p11">11. International transfers</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Some vendors may process data outside India.</p>
      <p>
        If we use infrastructure or processors outside India, we will use lawful transfer mechanisms and contractual safeguards required under applicable Indian law.
        Details will be expanded in the counsel-approved notice.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p12">12. Retention</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Keep what we need, then delete or de-identify.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Early-access records: while useful for launch planning and invite delivery, then deleted or anonymised</li>
        <li>Support / grievance messages: as needed to resolve the matter and for a reasonable follow-up period</li>
        <li>Account data: while active, then for a limited period after deletion for security, disputes, and legal duties</li>
        <li>Safety investigation records: longer where necessary</li>
        <li>Raw liveness media: shorter than verification outcome records (see section 5)</li>
      </ul>

      <h2 id="p13">13. Account deletion effects</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Deletion removes product access; some limited records may remain.</p>
      <p>When deletion completes:</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Your profile is removed from discovery</li>
        <li>Focus / Together / Era space participation for that account ends</li>
        <li>You lose access to chats and in-app media tied to the account</li>
        <li>Backups and security logs may persist for a limited period before purge</li>
        <li>Information needed for an open legal claim, fraud case, or mandatory retention may be kept in a restricted form</li>
      </ul>
      <p>Request deletion in-app when account settings are available.</p>

      <h2 id="p14">14. Security</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">We use safeguards; no method is perfect.</p>
      <p>
        We apply access controls, encryption in transit where appropriate, logging, and staff/process limits on sensitive data.
        Protect your devices and never share OTPs.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p15">15. Your rights (including export)</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Access, correction, deletion, consent withdrawal, and a copy of your data.</p>
      <p>Subject to law, you may request to:</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Access personal data we hold about you</li>
        <li>Correct inaccurate data</li>
        <li>Withdraw marketing consent</li>
        <li>Delete early-access or account data where applicable</li>
        <li>Receive an export of key account/profile data you provided (portable copy), in a commonly used format where feasible</li>
        <li>Nominate a contact for certain rights under DPDP once applicable to our processing</li>
      </ul>
      <p>
        Use <a class="text-link" href="/grievance">Grievance</a> or
        <a class="text-link" href="mailto:grievance@aynera.in">grievance@aynera.in</a>.
        We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling a request.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p16">16. Children</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Aynera is 18+ only.</p>
      <p>
        We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. If you believe a minor has submitted data, contact us and we will take steps to delete it.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p17">17. Cookies and similar tech</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Essential cookies first; analytics only if enabled.</p>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Type</th>
            <th>Purpose</th>
            <th>Examples</th>
            <th>Duration (typical)</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          <tr>
            <td>Essential</td>
            <td>Security, load balancing, form/session integrity</td>
            <td>Session or CSRF tokens, preference flags</td>
            <td>Session to a few months</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td>Functional</td>
            <td>Remember UI choices (for example dismissed banners)</td>
            <td>Local storage keys</td>
            <td>Until cleared</td>
          </tr>
          <tr>
            <td>Analytics (if enabled)</td>
            <td>Understand traffic and improve the site</td>
            <td>Privacy-respecting analytics IDs</td>
            <td>As set by the tool; often 1–24 months</td>
          </tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <p>
        You can control cookies in your browser. Blocking essential cookies may break parts of the site.
        A named vendor list will be added when analytics or marketing pixels are enabled.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p18">18. Safety and messaging</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Safety review may include limited access to reports and related content.</p>
      <p>
        If someone reports abuse, we may review relevant profile information, reports, and associated messages as needed to investigate.
        We do not sell message contents. Automated and human review may be used to detect spam or harmful behaviour.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p19">19. Grievance and privacy contact</h2>
      <p class="legal-summary">Use the grievance channel; named officer details coming before launch.</p>
      <div class="legal-callout">
        <strong>To be published before public launch:</strong> Grievance Officer / Data Protection contact name, email, phone, and postal address.
        Interim: <a class="text-link" href="mailto:grievance@aynera.in">grievance@aynera.in</a> and
        <a class="text-link" href="/grievance">Grievance</a>.
      </div>
      <p>We aim to acknowledge privacy requests promptly and respond within timelines required by applicable law once fully in force for our processing.</p>

      <h2 id="p20">20. Language</h2>
      <p>
        This Privacy Notice is published in English. If we later publish translations, the English version controls unless law requires otherwise.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p21">21. Changes</h2>
      <p>
        We may update this interim notice as the pilot evolves. Material changes after you have an account may also be communicated by email or in-app notice.
      </p>

      <h2 id="p22">22. Contact</h2>
      <p>
        Privacy questions and requests:<br />
        <a class="text-link" href="/grievance">Grievance channel</a><br />
        Email: <a class="text-link" href="mailto:grievance@aynera.in">grievance@aynera.in</a>
      </p>
      <p>
        <a class="text-link" href="/terms">Terms of Use</a> ·
        <a class="text-link" href="/safety">Safety</a>
      </p>
